evidence: Guest devices cannot access the internet even though the policy should restrict only internal servers.
Guest VLAN routes through R22 to the internet according to the topology information.
R22 has interface Gi0/0.70 configured with ip access-group GUEST-POLICY in.
Extended IP access list GUEST-POLICY contains rule '10 deny ip 192.168.70.0 0.0.0.255 any'.
root_cause: The GUEST-POLICY ACL applied to interface Gi0/0.70 denies all traffic from the guest subnet (192.168.70.0/24) to any destination, which incorrectly blocks internet access instead of restricting only internal servers.
verification: Run show access-lists and verify the GUEST-POLICY rules match the intended restrictions.
Test internet connectivity from a guest device after human review and approval.
fix_steps: Review the current GUEST-POLICY access list configuration using show access-lists.
Remove or modify the over-broad deny rule that blocks all traffic from 192.168.70.0/24 to any destination.
Configure specific deny statements in GUEST-POLICY targeting only the internal server subnets while permitting internet traffic.
Apply the updated access list to interface Gi0/0.70.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: ACL GUEST-POLICY rule denies guest subnet traffic broadly.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Restrict ACL GUEST-POLICY deny statements to internal server subnets only.
